svg.title: Forge — Create screen concept
svg.text: Type what you want below and Forge builds a real, wearable Roblox accessory from it. Every input is moderated.
Describe anything you can imagine and Forge builds a real,
wearable Roblox accessory — the fastest way to create.
glowing blue dragon wings made of crystal
A colour + a material + a shape works best — “gold crown made of lava”.
